[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended factors to consider when choosing waterproof hiking boots: waterproofing, ankle support, traction, comfort, and durability.

4. The North Face Hedgehog Fastpack GTX ($150-$190)  
5. La Sportiva Raptor GTX ($180-$220)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for staying hydrated during a hike:  
1. Bring enough water (2-3 liters per person for a day hike).  
2. Hydrate before hiking (1-2 hours prior).  
3. Drink regularly (every 20-30 minutes).  
4. Monitor urine color.  
5. Choose the right hydration pack.  
6. Avoid dehydration triggers (limit caffeine and alcohol).  
7. Bring electrolyte-rich snacks.  
8. Know the signs of dehydration.  
9. Plan hikes to avoid the hottest part of the day.  
10. Be prepared for emergencies.
